decision.reasoning_trace: During this shopping session, I narrowed my selection to products specifically functioning as backpacks. I included a mix of lightweight daypacks (ZOMAKE), tactical shoulder bags (G4Free), specialized waterproof dry bags (Piscifun), and sling bags (NICGID). I ultimately selected the ZOMAKE 20L Ultra Lightweight Hiking Backpack (prod_backpacks_173) because of its exceptional value, high rating (4.6), and the significant social proof provided by over 14,000 reviews. It serves as a highly versatile and reliable pack for the price.
